privacy.text: INTERIM VERSION — OWNER/LEGAL REVIEW OUTSTANDING
Published as an interim version: 10 November 2026. Owner/legal review remains outstanding.
1. About this notice

This notice describes the information handled by micmuproperties.com.ng. MICMU uses the business name MICMU Properties Limited. It covers website enquiries, inspections, accounts and related website records. Separate transaction documents may explain information needed for a particular property transaction.
Contact MICMU at:

items: B10/B11, Legacy Mall, 66 Ibusa Road, Asaba, Delta State, Nigeria.

privacy.text: 2. Information handled and purposes
Public pages can be viewed without an account. Features you use may involve:

items: Enquiries/support: name, email, phone, optional WhatsApp number, contact preference, message, request type and processing status. Inspection requests also include a property, preferred date/time and attendee count. These details support responding and arranging requested services.
Accounts: email, profile name, account identifiers, authentication/session information, permissions and MFA information where enrolled. Authentication is handled through Supabase.
Account services: saved properties/searches, notifications and read status, requests, assigned documents and payment records.

Realtor services: application/contact details, experience, previous-sales count, referrer code, review status, referral relationships, sales, instalments, receipts, agreement notes and commission records.
Administration: staff permission changes, audit events and information relating to approved public media or company profiles.

Technical/security processing: providers may handle IP addresses, URLs, device/browser details, timestamps and authentication/security events to deliver and protect the service. Enquiry identifiers and a derived email hash support duplicate and rate-limit checks; the stored enquiry is not anonymous.

privacy.text: These records support requested services, accounts, staff administration, transaction record-keeping and security. Form acknowledgement does not itself authorise marketing. Staff review application and transaction statuses; a calculator result or submitted application does not automatically approve a transaction.
Do not send passwords, MFA codes, card details or identity documents through public enquiry forms. Ask MICMU about an appropriate secure route if documents are needed.
3. Access, service providers and external services

Authorised staff can access records within their permissions. Approved realtors can see their direct referrals’ names/statuses and their permitted sales/commission records. Approved public biographies, media, testimonials and verification labels can be visible publicly.

Cloudflare provides website delivery/hosting and security, including Turnstile checks on configured enquiry forms. Supabase provides authentication, database and storage services. Authentication email requests pass through Supabase Auth and its configured delivery arrangements. Existing media may use Cloudflare R2 where configured. Other configured image hosts can receive browser requests when images load.

WhatsApp, Facebook, OpenStreetMap and video/tour links lead to external services when selected. Their privacy practices apply to their processing. Providers may process information outside Nigeria. This interim document does not specify the deployment regions, email delivery provider, additional operational recipients or transfer safeguards.
4. Cookies and browser storage
Authentication cookies maintain sign-in and session verification/refresh. Exact names and lifetimes depend on deployed settings. Clearing cookies may require signing in again.
Local browser storage remembers:

items: micmu-recently-viewed: up to 12 property slugs, with a dashboard clear-history control.
micmu-referral: a referral code for a realtor application.

privacy.text: These local values have no application-defined expiry and may remain until replaced or cleared through the browser. Clearing local history does not delete submitted enquiries or account records. Saved searches/properties are stored separately in the account database.

The service worker caches the public offline fallback and an illustration. Its implemented offline cache excludes private dashboards/documents, APIs and live property pages. Ordinary browser/provider caching is separate.

No advertising pixel, Google Analytics or optional analytics beacon was found in the inspected application source. That does not establish whether dashboard-injected analytics or provider security cookies are active. Search Console DNS verification does not add a visitor-tracking script. Blocking security scripts may prevent form verification from working.
5. Payments and the calculator

The website has no checkout or payment gateway. Payments are arranged directly with MICMU. Confirmed plans/rates apply to all sale properties. Calculator estimates do not create a purchase contract; the transaction requires MICMU’s written agreement.

Calculator inputs are processed locally in the browser without a calculation-submit API. Ordinary page-request metadata may still reach hosting providers. Staff-entered sales, receipts and payment/commission records are separate database records.
6. Retention and safeguards

This interim document does not specify retention periods or a deletion timetable. No scheduled general deletion programme was identified in the inspected code. A short-lived document link does not delete its underlying document; the enquiry rate-limit window is not a retention period.

The implementation includes permissions, staff MFA, database access restrictions and short-lived private document links. These reduce risk without guaranteeing absolute security. There is no general self-service account-erasure function.
7. Requests and complaints

Contact micmuproperties@gmail.com about access, correction, deletion or other privacy concerns. Do not send passwords or authentication codes. Depending on applicable law and circumstances, rights may include access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability, objection and withdrawal of consent where consent is the basis. Conditions and lawful retention requirements may apply; withdrawal does not affect processing already lawfully carried out.
You may also complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at https://ndpc.gov.ng/. Contacting MICMU does not remove that right.
8. Further information

The forms do not implement age verification or a parental-consent workflow. This document does not set an age threshold. Additional confirmed information and material changes should be reflected in a revised notice with its publication/effective date.

terms.text: INTERIM VERSION — OWNER/LEGAL REVIEW OUTSTANDING
Published as an interim version: 10 November 2026. Owner/legal review remains outstanding.
1. Website and contact
These terms describe use of micmuproperties.com.ng, which uses the business name MICMU Properties Limited.

Office: B10/B11, Legacy Mall, 66 Ibusa Road, Asaba, Delta State, Nigeria.
Email: micmuproperties@gmail.com. Phone: 07071281869. WhatsApp: 07078089132.
These website terms do not replace a property sale, tenancy or agency agreement. Information handling is described separately in the Privacy Notice.
2. Property information and verification

Listings, descriptions, photographs, plans and project updates provide information for enquiries. Confirm current availability, price, dimensions, specifications, title documents and charges with MICMU before proceeding. Illustrations/renderings should be read with their captions and may differ from completed properties.

Saving a property, sending an enquiry or using a calculator does not reserve a property or conclude a purchase. Internal reference checks confirm published MICMU records; they do not replace government title searches or establish a representative’s authority to receive a particular payment. Obtain appropriate independent professional checks before a transaction.
3. Requests and inspections

Supply accurate information you are entitled to share. A successful form submission means a request was saved. Inspections remain pending until MICMU confirms arrangements. Contact the team about access, rescheduling, cancellation and any applicable charges before relying on an appointment.
The website does not promise automatic email/WhatsApp notifications or a particular response time for enquiries or status changes.
4. Payment plans and written agreements

There is no online checkout or payment gateway. Arrange payments directly with MICMU and confirm authorised payment instructions through its verified contacts. Do not submit card information, bank login details or payment/authentication codes through public forms.
The confirmed plans apply to all sale properties:

The confirmed instalment allocation schedules remain unchanged. The calculator illustrates the amounts using the entered price and those confirmed plans. “Estimates” means calculator use does not create a purchase contract, reserve a property or approve credit; it does not mean the confirmed rates are unapproved.

A final transaction requires MICMU’s written agreement specifying the property price, payment schedule, charges and any expressly agreed discounts. Confirm deposits, refunds, cancellations, defaults and other transaction conditions in the relevant agreement. These website terms introduce no no-refund rule, forfeiture or late fee.
Dashboard payment/receipt records are entered by authorised staff and do not mean the website received or settled a payment. Report discrepancies to MICMU.
5. Accounts and submissions
Keep sign-in details secure and contact MICMU about suspected unauthorised use. Never share passwords, reset links or MFA secrets/codes. Staff permissions and MFA protect administrative access.

Do not access another person’s records, bypass security, interfere with the site, submit fraudulent information or upload unlawful material. Share only material you are authorised to provide. Keep private document links private and use an agreed secure route for sensitive documents.
Public team biographies do not grant login access. A general self-service account-deletion function is not currently provided; contact MICMU with account requests.
6. Realtor services
An account, referral or application does not itself authorise a person to represent MICMU, receive money or bind the company. Confirm representative authority directly.

Realtor applications are reviewed. Approved realtors can see their direct referrals’ names/statuses and their permitted sales/commission records. A recorded sale or displayed commission does not guarantee payout or replace the relevant written agency/commission agreement. Separate commission arrangements must be confirmed; the sale-property payment plans above are preserved.
7. External services and availability

External communications, map, video and tour links lead to other operators’ services with their own terms/privacy practices. Website availability may be interrupted by maintenance, faults or provider issues. The offline fallback does not contain current prices, availability or private account records. Confirm time-sensitive information directly with MICMU.
8. Questions, rights and changes
Send complaints or questions to micmuproperties@gmail.com or the office contacts above, including the relevant reference without passwords or authentication codes.

These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded. They introduce no liability cap, exclusive court jurisdiction or compulsory arbitration. Transaction-specific conditions belong in the relevant written agreement.

This interim version is dated above. Later approved revisions should state their publication/effective date. Website updates do not by themselves retrospectively vary an existing transaction or agency contract.
